Full summary: Implemented docs/TRIAGE-SPEC.md on feat/triage via 11-agent workflow + fix pass: resolution.ts/scope.ts extraction, buildTriage engine, fullSurface MCP tool, /api/triage, dashboard Triage tab, full §10 suite both backends. 107 test files / 1401 tests green, build clean.
Decisions: Chose to extend the scopeMatches extraction to the three byte-identical sqlite-stores.ts sites beyond the spec's file-store list — sqlite is the default backend and leaving parallel copies is the drift the extraction targets; guarded by the sqlite parity suite; Chose lazy-once-then-cached StoreSet construction in the /api/triage closure over the spec letter's eager construction — eager createStores materializes .twining/twining.db on uninitialized projects, breaking the §10.11 initialized:false contract; the spec's normative concern (no per-request churn) is satisfied; Chose window_ms: Infinity as an unbounded window per spec §4.1's 'no upper clamp' — supersedes the initial silent-default behavior; echoed window_ms serializes to JSON null through the adapters, asserted in tests; Chose controller-staged commits in the spec's four PR stages over a single squash — preserves the extraction/core/adapters/dashboard reviewability the spec's sequencing intends
Findings: Dashboard view refresh wiring (§8 mount/subscribe/tab-activation) is untested by repo convention — no jsdom in vitest config; pure helpers (deepLinkTab, stableKey, truncationLabel) are pinned instead; warning: dashboard Triage tab reaches plugin users only after a release runs bump-plugin-version.sh (bundle rebuild copies src/dashboard/public into plugin/server/public) — plugin/ deliberately untouched on this branch; need: spec §6.1 field-data observation window starts when twining_triage ships in a release — record the release date to anchor the 8-week promotion/removal test
